research-programme.title: Platform Communication and Digital Culture
research-programme.description: Examining how social media platforms, algorithms, and digital infrastructures shape political discourse, social movements, and collective meaning-making in contemporary societies.

research-programme.title: Conflict Narratives and Media
research-programme.description: Analyzing how media representations, military communication, propaganda, and narrative warfare function in contemporary conflicts, with particular focus on discursive strategies and counter-narratives.

research-programme.title: Critical Discourse Analysis
research-programme.description: Using critical discourse analysis and multimodal methods to examine power relations, ideologies, and knowledge production embedded in communication practices.

research-programme.title: Artificial Intelligence and Communication
research-programme.description: Investigating the implications of AI systems, large language models, and automated communication technologies for research, education, and public discourse.

research-programme.title: Higher Education and Academic Knowledge
research-programme.description: Examining institutional pressures, scholarly communication practices, and broader changes affecting academic work, intellectual freedom, and knowledge production.
